title: Example: copying embed snippets
summary: A sample Log post with embed and command snippets to try the copy buttons.

revisions.body:
A small example post to try the Log's code-copy buttons. Each button copies only the snippet below it, including indentation and line breaks.

## Embed snippet

This iframe is shown as code, so it can be copied without loading any external content.

```html
<iframe
  src="https://example.com/embed"
  title="Example embed"
  width="560"
  height="315"
  loading="lazy"
></iframe>
```

## Command snippet

Each code block has its own copy button.

```sh
printf 'Hello from the Log!\n'
```

This is an example post for testing the copy buttons.
